notes.title: Game Version 1.11
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.11! This version includes:
[list]
[*] The 9th region, which is the most difficult region yet
[*] Two new hero card portraits, and two new monster card portraits
[*] Some reward requirements have been lowered
[*] Rewards are rewarded more consistently
[/list]

If you experience any issues, be sure to post in the forums or email support@efuniversegames.com

notes.title: Game Version 1.08
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.08. This version includes:
[list]
[*] Challenges. When you defeat an EFU+ boss with 35 or less card (high card challenge) or with 20 or less cards (low card challenge), you'll earn a challenge token.
[*] Challenge tokens can be used to buy powerful upgrades, such as rank experience +100%, sacrifice experience +100, prestige token rewards +100%, combat token rewards +100%, new card compound stat +1, and more.
[/list]

Challenges are unlocked after you defeat the EFU+ boss in region 6. If you've already defeated that boss, you'll need to go back and defeat it again.

This update also includes:
[list]
[*] The experience needed for a card to rank up has been slightly reduced
[*] Sacrifice levels require slightly less experience
[*] Minor UI adjustments
[/list]

If you experience any issues, be sure to post in the forums or email support@efuniversegames.com

notes.title: Game Version 1.05
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.05. This version includes:
[list]
[*] A tile status window. When you're placing a card and have the inventory open, a small window will appear when you mouse over a card that shows any link boosts, link nulls or item cards that the target tile is effected by. The window also tells you if the card is effected by those things.
[*] Small improvements to the inventory.
[/list]

If you experience issues, be sure to post in the forums or email support@efuniversegames.com

notes.title: Game Version 1.04
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.04. This version includes:
[list]
[*]After drawing 500 cards, you'll be able to spend draw tokens on "boost points", which increase the potency of the next booster pack you open. The boost point menu can be opened using a new button that appears next to the boost pack purchase button (must have drawn at least 500 cards).
[*]It's now possible to drag and drop cards around the battle grid.
[*]Possible fix involving saved card sets
[/list]
Some additions in this update are rather complex and intricate. If you experience issues, be sure to post in the forums or email Support@EFUniverseGames.com

It's now possible to drag and drop cards around the battle grid.

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content:
The game has been updated to version 1.02. This version includes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some buttons would sometimes stay highlighted longer than intended
[*] Fixed an issue where the bonus chance single stat max option was not as random as intended
[*] The position of some UI widgets will be saved in between game sessions
[*] Added an option to reset ui widget positions to the optional settings menu
[/list]

If you experience an issue, be sure to post in the Steam forums or message: Support@EFUniverseGames.com
